ad_placement_notes: Per-post ad-network cap: only ONE brand-new offer acceptance succeeds per save_post (a second/third fresh offer is silently dropped, or errors with 'can not accept any more opportunities' / 'No primary ad slot available'). Workaround that WORKED this run: place the single highest-payout fresh offer via save_post, then fill remaining slots by embedding ALREADY-accepted opportunity IDs (from list_ad_opportunities status=accepted, send_by after target send) via edit_post_content. Also note: max ONE 'primary' (with-logo) ad per post; use 'secondary' for the rest.
